reason: The school is the one assigning it and the teacher checks it in class, so it is tied to marks, not just another app. At ₹249 a month it costs less than one tuition class, so I would keep it going after the pilot, but only if the weekly report shows the gap topics actually moving.
objection: Will my son actually do the 20 minutes after the first week, or will he just click through it? And will this show up in his unit test marks, or only in their own diagnostic?
would_change_my_mind: If the teacher stops checking it in class, or the weekly parent view shows he is skipping it, I will cancel and spend the money on tuition instead.
